case_id.$comment: Derived exactly as family_id + '-v' + canonical unsigned variant_index + '-r' + canonical unsigned replicate_index. Semantic validation rejects any other value.

generation_stage_hashes.$comment: Semantic validation requires the exact registered 14-row order, stage-specific domains, ordered source digests, and previous-stage hash chain. This truth-owned ledger is an integrity record only; it is not evidence that an evaluator independently executed or replayed the generator.

GenerationStageHashRecord.$comment: Hash preimage is the complete record with only stage_sha256 set to null. Rehashing this supplied record or its truth projections proves integrity only; scientific acceptance requires a separate evaluator-produced execution output, which is not represented by this schema.
